name: Prometheus
description: Metrics collection and alerting toolkit: scrape your services, query time series and power Grafana dashboards.

connection.title: Open Prometheus
connection.description: Prometheus has no login of its own. Anyone who can reach this URL can browse and query every metric it collects.

firstLogin.note: Turn on Password protection for this domain, or don't give it a public domain. It starts by scraping itself; add your own targets in /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml (kept in the prometheus_config volume) from the service terminal, then restart the service. Metrics are kept in the prometheus_data volume.

features.title: Metrics collection
features.description: Scrape metrics from your apps, servers and exporters.

features.title: PromQL queries
features.description: Query and graph time series from the built-in UI.

features.title: Works with Grafana
features.description: Add it as a data source in the Grafana app.
